entities.summary: Vandana Shiva is an Indian scholar, environmental activist, food sovereignty advocate, ecofeminist and anti-globalization author. She is often referred to as "Gandhi of grain" for her activism associated with the anti-GMO movement. Vandana Shiva was a writers & intellectuals from Dehradun (b. 1952-11-05, Dehradun). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
